scares.description: A blinding light suddenly appears followed by an explosion.
An explosion destroys a rescue boat, accompanied by clashing low piano notes.
Emiko is startled by something, followed by clashing notes.
As a Japanese soldier turns around, Godzilla roars from above a building.
It is revealed that Emiko was startled by fishes being liquified by the "oxygen destroyer", accompanied by clashing low notes.
